thread:
erin: starting migration window now for shards 10-20 — applying partial index for recent active sessions. low-risk DDL but backfill anticipated. will run canary first on 3 nodes.

deploybot: [deploy 3419876543] started by erin · commit abc1234 · canary 5% · steps: 1) apply DDL 2) run backfill job 3) validate counts · notify on failures

Code block:
```sql
ALTER TABLE user_sessions ADD INDEX idx_recent_active (user_id) WHERE last_active > now() - interval '90 days';
```

kai: holdpoint criteria? what's our abort signal for canary/backfill

erin: hold if lock_wait > 30s for more than 2 concurrent attempts, or replication lag > 500ms for >2 minutes. also abort if error rate on reads jumps >1.5x baseline.

deploybot: canary at 5% succeeded (3 nodes). scheduled ramp to 25% in 10m unless a hold is posted.

carol: I'm watching locks/QPS/disk iowait — dashboard: https://console.internal.redwood/dashboards/ops/migration-3419876543

erin: backfill estimate ~1.2M rows across shards 12-14. running in batches of 1000 with 1s throttle. command:
```bash
python tools/backfill.py --table user_sessions --shard 12-14 --batch 1000 --sleep 1
```

matt: release notes pushed: https://internal/docs/releases/3419876543 — callout for index addition and expected short window of elevated locks

dave: please pin app-service on canary hosts to 2.9.1 to avoid schema mismatch during ramp. kube command ready if needed.

sre-rotation: paging policy reminder — if migration task fails >3 retries or we see >2m steady lock_waits, page oncall@sre and escalate to infra lead.

deploybot: ramped to 25% (status update) — DDL applied on 4/5 canary nodes, backfills started on target shards.

erin: seeing a lock spike ~45s on shard13 during batch 23, paused backfill for shard13. not yet at abort threshold but close. holding overall ramp while we investigate.

carol: looking at lock owner — shows legacy-compact job holding tuple locks on shard13. tagging owner.

frank: (message from legacy-ops) pausing legacy compaction on shard13 now, ETA 2m to drain locks.

erin: decision: keep DDL applied (no full rollback) but pause all backfill work on shards touching legacy-compact until compaction finishes. global rollout stays paused at 25%. rollback hatch: if locks persist after two compaction pauses or we see repeated >60s waits, we'll trigger full revert (see below).

matt: noted — updating release notes with "paused ramp due to lock contention; rollback hatch available" and sending update to product stakeholders.

deploybot: To rollback DDL: `deploybot rollback 3419876543 --ddl-revert yes` · to resume ramp: `deploybot resume 3419876543 --confirm-pinned-app 2.9.1` · current state: DDL applied on canary nodes, backfill paused on shard13, global rollout halted at 25%.

erin: followups — (1) confirm compaction fully stopped before resuming any backfill on shard13; (2) ops: schedule a short quiesce window if compaction can't be paused and we need to unblock; (3) if we resume, do so in staggered 5% increments with 15m observation windows.

sre-rotation: acknowledged — oncall notified and standing by for paging. will create incident channel if we hit rollback hatch.

matt: thumbs up. will keep stakeholders updated. thanks all.
